newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU COMPLETES APPROVAL OF THYSSEN/KRUPP VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: EU COMPLETES APPROVAL OF THYSSEN/KRUPP VENTURE.

text.p: The European Commission said on Tuesday it had completed approval of the flat steel joint venture between German giants Thyssen Stahl AG and Krupp Hoesch Stahl AG.

The Commission said in a statement it did not believe competition problems would arise in the product areas of cold-rolled flat steel products less than 500mm in width and tailored blanks for the car industry.
On July 28, the Commission gave its blessing to most of the aspects of the venture, which was born from the ashes of a hostile takeover bid by Krupp for Thyssen.

The deal was assessed under the European merger regulation and the treaty on the European Coal and Steel Community depending on the products involved, which also included steel-service centres, transport services and trade in fertilisers.

Speculation over a full merger between the two steel companies has revived in recent days. Such a fusion would create Germany's fifth largest industrial company with about 65 billion marks in sales in capital goods, plant construction and related services as well as steel. -- Amelia Torres 322 2876841
